findings: The English annual plan closes 60+60+60 with distinct restricted choices and a 12 EC thesis after the first year and 48 second-year EC. The climate ethics option adds life-cycle impacts and governance to direct philosophical work rather than treating sustainability methods as philosophy. Its seven-course difference is substantive. A further mind option would share the same relevant courses, and the Dutch Plus variants do not define the English route.
